title: Mixed Event — Singing Among the Cherry Blossoms — Episode5 What We Took Back

meta.Event Outline: Ichika continues her singing practice with Nene in the hopes of improving as much as possible for Shiho. She decides to try performing on the street in order to gain more confidence, but what unexpected encounter awaits her there...?!

rows.Line: Main Street

rows.Speaker: Female High School Student A
rows.Line: Hey, she's pretty good!

rows.Speaker: Female High School Student B
rows.Line:
Yeah, I've seen her around lately.
Maybe she's in a band?

rows.Speaker: Female High School Student A
rows.Line: She could be. Let's go watch!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, those girls stopped by to watch.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (In that case, I should...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I should make sure they have as much fun as I do...!)

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line: Wow! She's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Man
rows.Line: Nice! A street performance!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you for listening!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (More and more people are stopping by now.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Some are even saying that my songs are good or even great...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That makes me so happy, and makes this so much fun!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'll keep practicing so that I can reciprocate this feeling with more and more people.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, I think I'll call it a day...

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Aww, no more?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, I thought I should get going and...

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Wait, could you play just a little longer? I didn't catch the beginning so...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Yeah, come on! Encore!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay, sure.
How does one more sound...?
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So many people stopped by today...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm glad that I've really been able to reach some of them too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I doubt that I'm making anyone's heart stir yet but... I'd be happy if my singing at least made an impression on someone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, that cherry blossom tree...
It's already in full bloom!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's so beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I'll go take a look.
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Such a nice breeze...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We used to come here for picnics, I think...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'd lay out a big tarp, Saki's mom would bring us all snacks and... Oh, that was when Honami started developing a taste for apple pies too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There was also that time I ended up outside the park after looking so hard for a four-leaf clover, and made everyone look for me instead.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. So many memories...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: After we decided to form a band and play Miku songs, I came here to listen to her music and...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Her music...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It brought us all back together...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Saki couldn't go to school because she was in the hospital, while I started to lose touch with Shiho and Honami...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (As much as I wanted the four of us to be friends again, I couldn't do anything back then.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (All I could do was watch as Shiho, Honami and I drifted further and further away from each other.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That was when I met Miku in SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (If she didn't ask me to play that one time, we would've stayed estranged from one another.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And Miku was the one that made me realize what my true feelings were...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She asked me about them and helped figure out what they were...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I was able to tell Honami after that and we finally started to come back together.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We couldn't have done it without you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you so much...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm always singing and playing her songs too...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I've been listening to her songs since I was little, but I think it goes beyond simply liking it...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Miku's songs have a special place in my heart.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I want to keep making new memories. I want her songs to be there every step of the way.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You deserve to hear this too...
